entries.name: TextOp Tracker 75k
entries.gap: Current simulation adapter uses actual position feedback. The pinned author hardware code sets odometry position to zero AND unconditionally zeros all 15 future position-error entries, with a separate initial-heading reference transform. This is not equivalent to merely setting our root position to zero. Verify the hardware policy file against this exact latest.onnx SHA and compare the complete C++ observation/reset/action path before admission.
entries.next_step: Resolve the recorded author deployment and input-contract gap before evaluation.
